_doc: Phase 2 T-2.2 — 1-minute synthetic chunked-transcript fixture for the sliding-window utterance assembler. 14 raw chunks → 10 ground-truth utterances. Boundary mix: 4 single-final-chunk utterances (Rule 2 punctuation), 4 multi-chunk utterances (interim partial then final, Rule 2 punctuation closes), 1 single final chunk that ends WITHOUT sentence-terminating punctuation (Rule 1 silence-gap closes via the next utterance's first chunk arrival), 1 multi-chunk closing utterance. All inter-utterance silence gaps ≥ 800 ms; intra-utterance gaps = 0 ms. AC gate: ≥ 80 % boundary correctness (matches/10) per docs/IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md row T-2.2.
